text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MX-012","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D29","page":1,"quote":"232"}],"comment":"Dimension D29 (232) has no tolerance, yet note N1 requires wire EDM to achieve ±0.01 mm accuracy for the cam profile, making this a functional dimension that must be explicitly toleranced. Without a stated tolerance the machinist will default to the general tolerance of ±0.5 mm, which contradicts the required precision and will cause the cam lifter pair to malfunction. The designer should add an explicit tolerance to D29 consistent with the ±0.01 mm requirement in N1.","recommended_correction":"Add an explicit tolerance to D29 matching the ±0.01 mm accuracy called out in note N1."},{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"MACHINING NOTES 1) BY WIRE EDM TO ACHIEVE ACCURACY OF ±0.01 mm PAIR IN CLAMP CONDITION, PAIR TO BE MARK FOR START POINT ITEM CODE (PREB93B305013 & PRE93B305014) 2) NO SHARP EDGES. 3) TIME TAKEN FOR TEMPERING AFTER HARDENING TO BE MENTIONED ."},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"91±0.05"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D6","page":1,"quote":"200.11±0.05"}],"comment":"Note N1 mandates wire EDM accuracy of ±0.01 mm, but multiple dimensions on the drawing (e.g., D1 \"91±0.05\", D6 \"200.11±0.05\") carry ±0.05 mm tolerances, directly contradicting the note. This contradiction leaves the machinist unsure whether to hold ±0.01 or ±0.05, risking scrap or rework. The designer should clarify whether the ±0.01 mm applies only to specific cam-profile features and update either the note or the individual dimension tolerances so they are consistent.","recommended_correction":"Revise note N1 to specify exactly which features require ±0.01 mm, or update the affected dimensions to match the note's requirement."}]}
